name: snowflake
description: Snowflake SQL API with key-pair JWT auth: run statements with bindings, poll async statements, page result partitions, cancel; agent tools read-only with a dedicated role

nodes.title: Execute statement
nodes.description: Run one SQL statement with ? bindings and return typed rows (paged with next_cursor). As an agent tool only read-only statements (SELECT, WITH, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) run unless SNOWFLAKE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

statement.description: One SQL statement, e.g. SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE status = ? LIMIT 100

bindings.description: Values for the ? placeholders in order; typed values as {"type": "DATE", "value": "2026-11-19"}

role.description: Role (default SNOWFLAKE_ROLE; nodes only, tools use SNOWFLAKE_TOOL_ROLE)

timeout_seconds.description: Statement timeout (default SNOWFLAKE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, which also caps tool calls)

wait.description: Wait up to SNOWFLAKE_WAIT_MS for the result; false returns the statement_handle at once

query_tag.description: QUERY_TAG for the query history (default graphrt)

max_rows.description: Maximum rows in this page (also capped by SNOWFLAKE_MAX_RESULT_BYTES)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Statement status
nodes.description: Check a statement started by execute; waits up to SNOWFLAKE_WAIT_MS and returns its first page of rows when it has finished

wait.description: Wait for it to finish (up to SNOWFLAKE_WAIT_MS)

max_rows.description: Maximum rows in this page (also capped by SNOWFLAKE_MAX_RESULT_BYTES)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Statement results page
nodes.description: Next page of a finished statement's rows (across result partitions), from a next_cursor

cursor.description: next_cursor from execute, get_statement_status or get_statement_results

max_rows.description: Maximum rows in this page (also capped by SNOWFLAKE_MAX_RESULT_BYTES)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
